verdict.rationale: Figma's design page claims 'best-in-class layout tools, type tools, and more' with 'full control over how you design' and pixel-level precision, which loosely supports precise alignment for interface work. Nothing in the pack mentions a pen tool, path or vector-network editing, or boolean operations. Missing for 10: documented pen/path editing, boolean operations, specific alignment/snapping tooling, independent or hands-on corroboration of vector editing quality.
